acceptedInterpretation: B-1995 implements exactly Wave 1: verificationIntent-owned planned-path declarations, optional reference-only topology normalization and observe diagnostics, a dedicated derived read-only acceptance_matrix command, and focused compatibility and non-gating proof. It excludes Wave 1A coverage-basis discovery and signing plus all lifecycle enforcement.
notes: The four milestone rows preserve the approved plan canonical ownership and rollout boundary; no competing acceptance matrix artifact is introduced.
